# Multinomial Logistic Regression

```{r}
df <- readRDS("./cleaned_data/2026-04-26-atp_matches_best_of_3_ELO.rds")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    surface = as.factor(surface),
    player1_hand = as.factor(player1_hand),
    player2_hand = as.factor(player2_hand),
    set1_diff = as.numeric(set1_diff)
  ) %>%
  drop_na(match_outcome) %>%
  mutate(match_outcome = factor(match_outcome))

```

# Split data into train / test set
```{r}
set.seed(42)
df_split <- initial_split(df, prop = 0.8)
df_train <- training(df_split)
df_test  <- testing(df_split)

# cross-validation folds
df_folds <- vfold_cv(df_train, strata = match_outcome)
```

# Recipe
```{r}
mult_nom_recipe <- 
  recipe(
    match_outcome ~ rank_diff + elo_diff + set1_diff + age_diff + ht_diff + 
      surface + player1_hand + player2_hand,
    data = df_train
  ) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_lincomb(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_center(rank_diff, elo_diff, set1_diff, age_diff, ht_diff)

```


# Prep and bake recipe
```{r}
train_prep <- mult_nom_recipe %>% prep() %>% bake(new_data = NULL)
test_prep  <- mult_nom_recipe %>% prep() %>% bake(new_data = df_test)

```


# Fit Multinomial Logistic Regression (nnet)
```{r}
# model
multi_lr_model <- multinom_reg() %>%
  set_mode("classification") %>%
  set_engine("nnet")

# workflow
multi_lr_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(mult_nom_recipe) %>%
  add_model(multi_lr_model)

# cross-validation 
multi_lr_resamples <- fit_resamples(
  multi_lr_wf,
  resamples = df_folds,
  control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE)
)

```


```{r}
multi_lr_resamples %>% collect_metrics()
```

```{r}
# predict on test set
mult_lr_test <- multi_lr_wf %>%
  last_fit(split = df_split) %>% 
  collect_predictions()
```


# Metrics on TEST set
```{r}

# --- Accuracy ---
acc <- multi_lr_wf %>%
  last_fit(split = df_split) %>% 
  collect_metrics() %>% 
  filter(.metric == "accuracy") %>% pull(.estimate)
acc
```


```{r}
cm <- mult_lr_test %>% conf_mat(estimate = .pred_class, truth = match_outcome)
cm
```

```{r}
# Per-class accuracy
per_class_accuracy <- diag(cm[[1]]) / colSums(cm[[1]])
per_class_accuracy
```


```{r}
# --- Calibration ---
# 1. Pivot only the probability columns
calibration_df <- mult_lr_test %>%
  mutate(actual = as.character(match_outcome)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`.pred_LL`, `.pred_LWL`, `.pred_LWW`, `.pred_WLL`, `.pred_WLW`, `.pred_WW`),
    names_to = "class",
    values_to = "prob"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    class = gsub(".pred_", "", class),  # convert ".pred_LL" → "LL"
    class = as.character(class)
  )

# 2. Compute multi-class calibration
multi_calibration <- calibration_df %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  summarise(
    observed = sum(actual == class),
    total_pred_prob = sum(prob),
    calibration = total_pred_prob / observed
  )

multi_calibration
```

```{r}
# # --- Log-loss ---
# # N := #matches
# N <- set1_mult_lr_test %>% nrow()
# 
# # y := actual outcome of set 1
# y <- as.numeric(set1_mult_lr_test$set1_diff_cat)
# # pi := probability that player with higher rank will win
# pi <- set1_mult_lr_test$pred_class_prob
# 
# # Log-loss
# log_loss <- (-1) / N * sum(y * log(pi) + (1-y)*log(1-pi))

```

```{r}
# ---- Step 1: Reshape to long format ----
logloss_df <- mult_lr_test %>%
  mutate(actual = as.character(match_outcome)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`.pred_LL`, `.pred_LWL`, `.pred_LWW`, `.pred_WLL`, `.pred_WLW`, `.pred_WW`),
    names_to = "class",
    values_to = "prob"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    class = gsub(".pred_", "", class)  # ".pred_LL" → "LL"
  )

# ---- Step 2: Keep only rows where class == actual ----
true_class_prob <- logloss_df %>%
  filter(class == actual)

# ---- Step 3: Compute multi-class log loss ----
N <- nrow(mult_lr_test)

log_loss <- - mean(log(true_class_prob$prob))
log_loss
```



```{r}
mult_nom_metrics = tibble(
  metric = c("accuracy", "calibration", "log-loss"),
  estimate = c(acc, mean(multi_calibration$calibration), log_loss)
)

mult_nom_metrics
```
